{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
num_duplicates = len(duplicate_patients)

# Check how many rows per patient_id
duplicates_summary = data['patient_id'].value_counts().value_counts()

# Print summary
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {num_duplicates}")
print(f"Distribution of rows per patient_id:\n{duplicates_summary}")"}
